goal: Describe your studies and your final-year project in simple sentences.

phrases.example: I have a degree in computer science.
I studied at a university in Karachi.

meaning.roman: Mera final-year ka project ... ke baare mein tha.

phrases.example: My final-year project was about a simple app for students.
I learned how to work in a team.

task.roman: Apni taleem ke baare mein batayein: degree, jagah aur saal.

roleplay.model_answer: I have a degree in computer science. I studied at a university in Lahore and I finished in 2024.

roleplay.tutor_line: Which subject did you enjoy the most, and why?

task.roman: Apna pasandida subject aur uski wajah batayein.

roleplay.model_answer: I enjoyed statistics the most. I like working with numbers, and I learned how to find simple answers from data.

roleplay.tutor_line: Tell me about your final-year project.

task.roman: Apne final-year project ke baare mein do ya teen jumle bolein.

roleplay.model_answer: My final-year project was about a simple app for students. It helped them find study groups near their homes.

roleplay.tutor_line: What was your part in the project?

task.roman: Batayein ke project mein aap ne kya kaam kiya.

roleplay.model_answer: I wrote the main report and I tested the app. I learned how to explain technical ideas in simple words.

roleplay.tutor_line: What did you learn from your studies that is useful at work?

task.roman: Batayein ke taleem se aap ne kya seekha jo daftar ke kaam mein madadgar hai.

roleplay.model_answer: I learned how to manage my time and how to work in a team. These skills are useful in any office.

review_notes: The examples assume a university degree. Should I add a line or two for learners with an intermediate or diploma background?
